urn:csabs:concept/SumType.axiomBasis: Extensional total set-like types: constructor/eliminator beta and eta equations; operation-definition equations where specified. Equality of functions is pointwise; no divergence, effects, or bottom values.
urn:csabs:concept/SumType.basisScope: Defining interface and selected derived results for the operations listed in this entry. Not an enumeration of all consequences or all alternative foundations.
urn:csabs:concept/SumType.definition: The tagged disjoint union of A and B: each value is exactly a left-tagged A value or a right-tagged B value, eliminated by exhaustive case analysis.
urn:csabs:concept/SumType.mathematicalFormulation: A+B has disjoint constructors inl:A→A+B and inr:B→A+B. Each constructor is injective, inl(a)≠inr(b), and case(f,g)(inl(a))=f(a), case(f,g)(inr(b))=g(b).
urn:csabs:concept/SumType.reviewStatus: editorial basis review; no machine-checked mathematical proof
verificationObligation: Instantiate type parameters and operation domains.
Function equality here is extensional; translating to intensional type theory may require function extensionality.
Account separately for nontermination, exceptions, mutation, or untagged representation in concrete software.
Use the stated carriers, equality, domain restrictions and semantic conventions; alternative conventions require an explicit variant.

urn:csabs:operation/sum-case.description: Eliminates a sum by applying the branch corresponding to its constructor. Write [f,g](s)=case(f,g,s).
urn:csabs:operation/sum-case.name: case
